scope: Local feed/nav API answers on a B 站-shaped page; not logged-in Bilibili

results.test: feed mounts right after the native recommendation area and replaces the site lazy loader
unfilled skeleton slots after the last real card are hidden
two lanes request concurrently with distinct page indices, WBI-signed, always ps=12 like the site
a 24-card setting becomes 25 in a 5-column grid (whole rows, leftovers carried); 12-card requests merged; duplicates, ads, live dropped
cards on screen are fully visible shortly after landing; nothing waits hidden for an observer
⋮ opens a small menu (稍后再看 / 不感兴趣 / 不想看此 UP 主) outside the card (fixed, no card / link ancestor); Esc closes it
不感兴趣 shows a B 站-style placeholder (blurred cover, 已减少此类推荐, 撤销, ×, 知道了): no link inside, no card / link ancestor, links in the card lose href / target
the placeholder stays put (no early refill): still there 4.5 s later with the pointer away
撤销 (real mouse, plus a middle click) with B 站-style delegated window.open listeners registered first: nothing opens; the same card and its links come back
on screen it never folds by itself: hovered past 8 s, then 4 s after the pointer leaves, still there
知道了 dismisses at once; following cards glide into place (FLIP) and a spare card refills the row
scrolled away by the user after only ~1.5 s on screen: it waits (minimum 8 s visible)
layout shifts that push it off screen (without user scroll, or for < 1 s) do not fold it
after ≥8 s on screen, a user scroll that keeps it out of the viewport for >1 s folds it (and refills the row)
side indicator shows the batch crossing the middle of the viewport
scrolling keeps appending batches (2 -> 4) and the indicator follows
risk-control answer pauses loading with plain-language text, retry, one-click stable mode and collapsible details; no further requests
retry resumes loading
36 → 35 cards × 3 lanes and 12 → 10 cards × 1 lane (whole 5-column rows) keep loading, still ps=12
turning the option off removes the feed and restores the native lazy loader
no uncaught errors
